notes.title: ATC Flight Operator - Recent Update
notes.notes:
[p]Changelog:

Several performance fixes and in-game tweaks have been made to improve the overall experience.

(August 11th, 2025)[/p]

notes.title: Diverted Planes Bug - Fixed
notes.notes:
After some players were reporting that their planes were randomly being diverted and causing them to have a failing score,  I have investigated and release a quick patch to address this.

Please direct any other bugs or related bugs to the community hub and I will get back to you promptly.

Thank you and enjoy!
